items.title: Who is holding Jensen Huang accountable? It sure looks like nobody
items.summary: Sozzi Unleashed host Brian Sozzi digs into day two of Jensen Huang's return to Nvidia. Including a Financial Times report that interim CEO Colette Kress was left out of the talks to bring Huang back, a Wall Street Journal report that Huang disclosed more affairs to the board than previously known, why Brian says Nvidia is effectively a "board of one," and what history says about returning founders from Steve Jobs and Howard Schultz to Kevin Plank.
